content.title: Who Plays Mr. Cohen on 'The Pitt?' Where You Recognize This Familiar Actor From
content.text: Key PointsDann Florek guest-stars on 'The Pitt' as Eddie Cohen.Florek is best known as Captain Cragen from L'aw & Order' and its spin-offs.Upcoming guest stars include Sara Wyle, Mary McCormack, and Geoffrey Owens. Captain Cragen, what are you doing here!? Another head-scratchingly familiar guest star made his debut on The Pitt this week, portraying Mr. Eddie Cohen, the elderly husband of one of the latest patients in the emergency room at Pittsburgh Trauma Medical Center. Chances are, you immediately locked onto Dann Florek’s face when his character accompanied his wife’s stretcher as she was guided into her hospital room by the EMTs who transported her, who reported she was involved in a “very low speed” accident in which she was struck by a slow-moving vehicle and fell to the ground, bruising her hip. He quickly became a patient too after staff realized he was behind the wheel of the vehicle, with the driver swearing the car “wasn’t even moving” and his wife certain he had backed into her. Doctors uncovered an unexpected degradation to his baseline status, thanks to a combination of medications he was prescribed that caused him to lose his balance, which the script implies may have caused him to not realize the car was moving. Dann Florek on the set of ‘Law & Order: SVU.’Photo by NBC on Getty Images What Is Dann Florek Known For? Most notably, Florek portrays Captain Donald ‘Don’ Cragen in the Law & Order universe, first appearing on the flagship series beginning in 1990, and later swinging by for a few episodes of Law & Order: Organized Crime. He’s also been featured on hundreds of episodes of Law & Order: Special Victims Unit. You may also know his face from one of his many single-episode appearances on shows like The Equalizer, Matlock, 21 Jump Street, and Sabrina the Teenage Witch. He enjoyed a three-episode arc on Roseanne, and almost two dozen episodes of L.A. Law in the ‘90s. Florek’s arc emotionally depicted the impacts of aging and healthcare on a person’s independence, as he fought to remain at home with his wife despite concerns from his daughter and providers that it may not be safe for them to continue living on their own. Who Else Is Guest-Starring on ‘The Pitt’? Next up, star Noah Wyle’s wife Sara Wyle makes an appearance, set to debut on the popular series in the next episode as another of the season’s many patients. Unfortunately, little is known about her role yet, but you can expect to see her on your screens in Season 2, Episode 13. In the same episode, The West Wing’s Mary McCormack will appear as neurosurgeon Dr. Linda Conley, while Cosby Show alum Geoffrey Owens is said to be appearing soon as a cardiothoracic surgeon. Jeff Kober also marked a big guest spot, appearing as Dr. Robby’s friend Duke across several episodes this season, and fans were gobsmacked to see Glee alum Max Adler as a friend of Nurse Emma’s attacker. About the authorSammi Burke is a breaking news writer for Parade, where she writes content relating to celebrities, entertainment and other trending news.
